visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black hoodie and black leggings, stands gesticulating with both hands while looking directly at the lens. Beside her is a white motorcycle featuring vibrant pink and yellow decals, with a colorful helmet resting on its seat. The setting is an outdoor motorcycle inspection center under a bright, cloudless sky, with buildings and a large red-and-yellow vertical sign visible. Large Traditional Chinese subtitles and a social media logo appear as overlays on the lower and upper portions of the frame. (2) The camera switches to a medium shot, capturing the woman pointing toward the tall '芳美檢驗廠' sign, which has large black characters on a red and yellow background. The ground is paved with a grid of green and gray tiles, and several blue plastic barrels are situated in the background near a building entrance. The lighting is harsh and natural, creating clear shadows on the ground as the woman continues her enthusiastic explanation. Animated yellow variety text pops up to emphasize her words as she shifts her body weight while talking. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman as she holds up a white inspection document with both hands, showing several official red stamps and printed numbers. Digital gold confetti and a green checkmark icon are overlaid on the screen to signify a successful outcome. The background becomes slightly blurred, though the architectural details of the inspection facility remain recognizable. Brightly colored variety text in red and yellow fills the bottom of the screen, mirroring her celebratory facial expressions and wide eyes. (4) A screen recording of a website interface is displayed, showing a white background with a table titled with Traditional Chinese text. The table lists a vehicle license plate number 'BC-867' in a gray cell, while other parts of the site feature red headers and blue links. Large red and yellow variety text overlays the bottom of the interface, providing a visual summary of the on-screen data. The lighting of the screen capture is flat and uniform, contrasting with the previous natural outdoor scenes. (5) Returning to the outdoor setting, the woman is seen sitting on the white and pink motorcycle, triumphantly raising the paper document with her right arm extended high. The colorful graphics on the motorcycle's fairing and the detailed texture of her black hoodie are clearly visible in the bright sunlight. Behind her, a red banner with white text and various store signs line the street. The camera captures her from a medium shot, emphasizing her successful pose as the final variety text and subtitles appear on screen.

It serves as both a lifestyle vlog for motorcycle enthusiasts and an informative guide on verifying inspection records through the government's official website.
